dedupe_keys.name: network data of the district heating system of flensburg 2014 2024

description: This series gives measured operating data for the whole district heating network of Flensburg, Germany: total heat load (heat output) and feed flow temperatures. The first part, for 2014 to 2016, was published by the utility Stadtwerke Flensburg GmbH; the parts for 2017 to 2019 and 2020 to 2024 were published by researchers Jonas Freißmann, Malte Fritz and Ilja Tuschy with the utility, who ask that questions go to the researchers. The average return flow temperature can be assumed to be 50 degrees Celsius. Coverage is the Flensburg network over 2014 to 2024 at hourly resolution. Files are one CSV for 2014 to 2016 under CC-BY-SA-4.0 and XLSX workbooks for the later periods under CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, all on Zenodo at no cost; the latest part was published in September 2025. Caveats: the later files are for non-commercial use only, return temperatures are not measured in the published data, and the data describe the network as a whole, not individual plants or substations. Simulation uses are district heating dispatch optimisation, storage and heat pump sizing, and demand forecasting. Related records: data-sonderborg-district-heating-plants is a similar data set from Denmark.
